story.name: 1️⃣ 故事結構（三段式）
questions: 故事寫作一般分為幾多段？
Paragraph 1 Opening / 2 Body / 3 Ending — 三段落係基本要求
故事的背景（時間地點）和人物
故事的背景（時間地點）和人物
Checklist: Opening 要寫 setting (time & place) + characters
Ending 要總結故事＋帶出 moral lesson（教訓）
寫 Fiona 公主故事時，要用幾多段落？
P.6 Checklist: Write in four paragraphs（圖 1-4 各配一段）
故事開頭常用邊個模板？
One day, [人物] was at [地方] at [時間]. Suddenly...
One day, [人物] was at [地方] at [時間]. Suddenly...
Opening 模板：One day, [人物] was at [地方]. Suddenly, [事件]...

tense.name: 2️⃣ 過去式敘事
questions: 故事寫作主要用邊種時態？
整個故事主要用過去式，保持時態一致
Kathy had breakfast. Then she went to school.
Kathy had breakfast. Then she went to school.
Kathy have breakfast. Then she goes to school.
Kathy has breakfast. Then she go to school.
Kathy had breakfast. Then she goes to school.
過去式：had / went 都要係過去式，唔可以一時過去一時現在
「Fiona ___ as gentle as a lamb.」應填邊個？
故事用過去式敘事 → There was / Fiona was
日記（Diary）通常用邊種時態寫？
Checklist: Use the past tense to write the diary.
There was a beautiful princess called Fiona.
There was a beautiful princess called Fiona.
There is a beautiful princess called Fiona.
There was a beautiful princess calls Fiona.
There were a beautiful princess called Fiona.
There was + 單數名詞 + 過去式 called

punct.name: 3️⃣ 對話標點
questions: 「Don't worry____ said Mum.」空格應填邊個標點？
對話後嘅說明要加逗號：「Don't worry,」said Mum.
對白用引號＋句末標點喺引號內，shouted 開頭唔使大寫
「Let me go!」呢句用咩標點表達強烈語氣？
驚嘆號（exclamation mark）表強烈感情，Checklist 有提
I will help you, he promised.
對白引號內＋逗號＋說明（he promised 唔大寫）

ifclause.name: 4️⃣ If 條件句
questions: If 條件句正確結構係？
If + 現在式, will + 原形動詞
If + 現在式, will + 原形動詞
If + 現在式, 過去式
If clause 用現在式（present），main clause 用 will + 原形
邊句 If 條件句正確？
If I study, I will pass the exams.
If I study, I will pass the exams.
If I will study, I pass the exams.
If I studied, I will pass the exams.
If I study, I passed the exams.
If I study（現在式）+ I will pass（will + 原形）
「If she practices every day, she ___.」應填邊個？
主句用 will + 原形 → will improve
邊個係錯誤嘅 If 句？
If I will go, I will join you.
If I will go, I will join you.
If I go, I will join you.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If she tries, she will succeed.
If 後面唔可以加 will！If + 現在式

soth.name: 5️⃣ So that（目的）
questions: 「I always watch English programmes, ___ I can improve my English.」應填邊個？
so that 表目的：做某事嘅意圖（後面可以 can/will）
表達做某事嘅目的或意圖
表達做某事嘅目的或意圖
so that = 目的（以便、為了）；because 先係原因
邊句用 so that 正確？
He studies hard so that he can pass.
He studies hard so that he can pass.
He studies hard so that he passed.
He studies hard because so that he can pass.
He studies hard so that he will passed.
so that + can/will + 原形動詞
in order that 同義，但 so that 更口語自然

conn.name: 6️⃣ 連接詞（次序）
questions: 以下邊組係連接詞（link up ideas）？
連接詞：first / next / then / after that / after / before / although / suddenly / finally
寫日記/故事時，次序連接詞放喺邊？
每個新步驟或情節嘅開頭
每個新步驟或情節嘅開頭
First / Next / Then / Finally 引導每步發展，令文章連貫
「___ the witch came, Fiona was scared.」應填邊個？
Suddenly（突然）帶出轉折情節；Finally 係總結
「After ___ the pills, she felt strange.」應填邊個？

adv.name: 7️⃣ 方式副詞
questions: adverbs of manner = 形容詞 + -ly（happy → happily）
修飾動詞 smiled → 副詞 happily
修飾動詞 laugh → 副詞 wickedly（wicked + -ly）
修飾動詞 sang → 副詞 beautifully

simile.name: 8️⃣ Similes 明喻
questions: Simile 用邊兩個詞比較事物？
Simile = 用 like / as 比較兩樣有共同特質嘅事物
「She is as sweet as ___」應填邊個？
as sweet as honey（15 個必學 similes 之一）
「The princess' hair is as smooth as ___」應填邊個？
as smooth as silk（工作紙例句）
「Fiona was as gentle as a ___」應填邊個？
as gentle as a lamb（15 個必學 similes）
「He is as wise as an ___」應填邊個？
as wise as an owl（貓頭鷹＝智慧）
Simile 中間嘅形容詞要用邊種形式？
原形（as + adjective 原形 + as）
原形（as + adjective 原形 + as）
⚠️ 易錯：as better as ❌；正確係 as + 原形 + as
「The witch is as cunning as a ___」應填邊個？
as cunning as a fox（狐狸＝狡猾）
「The princess is as happy as a ___」應填邊個？
as happy as a lark（百靈鳥＝快樂）

report.name: 9️⃣ Reported Speech（轉述）
questions: 「The witch told Fiona ___ to escape.」應填邊個？
轉述命令：told sb + not + to + 原形（told Fiona not to escape）
「Let me go!」轉述成 reported speech 係？
Fiona told the witch to let her go.
Fiona told the witch to let her go.
Fiona said the witch to let her go.
Fiona told the witch let me go.
Fiona told the witch to let me go.
轉述命令：told sb + to + 原形；me → her
The witch told Fiona not to try to escape.
The witch told Fiona not to try to escape.
The witch told Fiona don't try to escape.
The witch told Fiona not to escape try.
The witch told Fiona to not try escape.
否定命令：told sb + not + to + 原形
Reported speech 用喺故事寫作嘅作用？
轉述人物說話，令情節更生動
轉述人物說話，令情節更生動
Checklist: 用 reported speech 轉述說話（The witch told Fiona not to escape）

pos.name: 🔟 積極思維＋正面結局
questions: 邊句展現積極思維（positive thinking）？
It is too difficult for me.
Checklist: 用 positive thinking 結尾，例如 I would keep trying
正面詞彙：thankful / grateful / hopeful / determined / optimistic / responsible
故事結尾嘅正確做法係？
Ending 要有感悟：From this experience, [人物] learnt that...
Fiona 故事可以帶出邊個教訓？
Checklist 提示：not be greedy / be thankful / ... more important than ...
「This story teaches us to be ___」應填邊個？
正面品質結尾：This story teaches us to be kind / responsible...

expand.name: 1️⃣1️⃣ 5W1H 擴句法
questions: 5W1H 擴句法包括邊六個問題？
Who / What / When / Where / How / Why
Who / What / When / Where / How / Why
Who / When / Why / Because / So / If
What / How / Where / But / And / Or
When / Where / What / Who / Which / Whose
5W1H：Who/What（主詞動作）、When（時間）、Where（地點）、How（方式感受）、Why（原因）
「Eva and I sold flags.」點樣加 When？
Eva and I sold flags today.
Eva and I sold flags today.
Eva and I sold flags Yuen Long.
Eva and I sold flags excitedly.
Eva and I sold flags for charity.
「We were selling flags ___ Yuen Long.」應填邊個？
Where = 地點 → in Yuen Long
「Many ___ passersby came to us.」應填邊個形容詞？
加形容詞令描寫更生動：Many kind-hearted and generous passersby came to us.
擴句（sentence expansion）令描寫由平淡變畫面感

diary.name: 1️⃣2️⃣ 日記格式

2026-10-18 評估 Section C：至少 80 字、30 分
過去式＋連接詞＋正確標點＋正面結尾
過去式＋連接詞＋正確標點＋正面結尾
